2023-04-06
Claim reported by the insured's representative following a sideswipe that occurred while the claimant was changing
lanes. The claimant reports a wrist fracture and is represented by counsel, so all further contact will be routed through
the attorney's office.
2023-05-27
Reviewed the driver listing and confirmed the claimant is named on the policy as a driver. Coverage was in force at
the time of loss, and nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage predates the policy start.
2023-05-30
Obtained the police report, witness statements, and scene photographs. All three sources describe the claimant's
vehicle as being in the adjacent lane when the other vehicle drifted over, and the other driver's account matches.
2023-06-03
Inspected the vehicle. The damage pattern along the driver side is consistent with the impact described, and no prior
damage in the same area appears in our records or the photos.
2023-08-19
Spoke with the claimant's attorney. The client's account of the collision has stayed the same in every conversation so
far. Medical records show a wrist fracture that is a plausible injury for this type of crash, and no earlier injury to the
same area is on file.
2023-10-08
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this fracture, so the file is being monitored and the treating
provider's records have been requested to confirm the course of care.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
